MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_CONTRAST_WOUND.title: Contrast Wound
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_CONTRAST_WOUND.descrip: Deal {DamageBase:diff()} + {PerForgive:diff()} x this combat's forgiveness count [color=#6666cc]damage[/color]. MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_CONTRAST_WOUND.yesNoPr: Add 1 [b]Original Sin curse[/b] to your hand and forgive it?
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DUAL_TRACK_DAY.title: Dual Track Day
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DUAL_TRACK_DAY.descrip: Gain {ShuangGuiRiPower:diff()} [b]Dual Track Day[/b]. After any Original Sin triggers Punish, you may immediately forgive another Original Sin among all cards.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_FULL_COURT_VERDICT.des: Choose any number of Original Sins among all cards to [b]punish for free[/b]; the rest are [b]forgiven automatically[/b]. If forgiven > punished: draw the difference. If punished ≥ forgiven: gain energy equal to the difference and lose {HpMult:diff()} HP per point of difference.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_FULL_COURT_VERDICT.sel: Choose Original Sins to punish (unselected ones are forgiven)
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_INDICTMENT.title: Indictment
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_INDICTMENT.description: Choose 1 of 3 random Original Sin curses to add to your draw pile with the Original Sin component. {IfUpgraded:show:Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#6666cc]Block[/color].|}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SIN_GIFT.title: Gift of Sin
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SIN_GIFT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#6666cc]damage[/color]. Gain a random Original Sin curse with the Original Sin component.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SIN_MARKET.title: Sin Market
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SIN_MARKET.description: Reveal all cards with Original Sin in combat (hand/draw/discard). Choose {SelectCount:diff()} cards; each randomly triggers one effect: 1)forgive immediately 2)return to your hand 3)auto-play once. If fewer than needed, you may gain Original Sin curses to make up the count.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SIN_MARKET.yesNoPrompt: Add 1 [b]Original Sin curse[/b] to your hand to make up the count?
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SIN_OFFERING.title: Sin Offering
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SIN_OFFERING.descripti: Exhaust 1{IfUpgraded:show:~2|} hand card(s); if an exhausted card is an Original Sin curse, exhaust 1 more hand card; if none of the exhausted cards were Original Sin curses, add a random Original Sin curse with the component to your hand.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_REDEMPTION_CORRIDOR.de: Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#6666cc]Block[/color]. Generate 1 Original Sin curse with the component into your hand, and Forgive it once.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZHI_MING_HUAN_YA.title: Remand
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZHI_MING_HUAN_YA.descr: Put 1 Original Sin curse from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw pile, then draw 1 card; if there is none in discard, you may choose to add an Original Sin curse with the component. {IfUpgraded:show:Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.|}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZHI_MING_HUAN_YA.selec: Choose 1 Original Sin curse in discard
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZHI_MING_HUAN_YA.yesNo: Add 1 [b]Original Sin curse[/b] to your draw pile?
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_NI_NI_ZHI_ZHENG.title: Token of Contempt
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_NI_NI_ZHI_ZHENG.descri: Gain {NiNiZhiZhengPower:diff()} [b][Token of Contempt][/b]. Whenever you Punish an Original Sin, gain 1 stack; each stack gives 1 Strength.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_KUAN_SHU_YIN_JI.title: Mark of Forgiveness
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_KUAN_SHU_YIN_JI.descri: Gain {KuanShuYinJiPower:diff()} [b][Mark of Forgiveness][/b]. Whenever you Forgive an Original Sin, gain 1 stack; at the start of next turn after the draw phase, draw cards equal to your stacks, then reset.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_XING_JIA_JIA_SHEN.desc: Gain {XingJiaJiaShenPower:diff()} [b][Shackles][/b]. After the first{IfUpgraded:show: two|} Original Sin curse card(s) played each turn, reduce its cost by 1, add Exhaust, and return it to your hand.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_XUN_HUAN_FA_DIAN.title: Codex of Reincarnation
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_XUN_HUAN_FA_DIAN.descr: Gain {XunHuanFaDianPower:diff()} [b][Codex of Reincarnation][/b]. Whenever you Forgive/Punish an Original Sin, if that card entered the discard/exhaust pile, put it on top of your draw pile instead; then randomly trigger an equal number of Original Sin card effects based on the Sin cards in your deck.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZUI_YE_SHENG_DUN.title: Shield of Sin
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZUI_YE_SHENG_DUN.descr: Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#6666cc]Block[/color]; permanently gain 1 additional Block for each Forgive or Punish that has occurred this combat.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_JI_HEN_FAN_SHI.title: Backlash of Envy
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_JI_HEN_FAN_SHI.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#6666cc]damage[/color] and gain 1 Original Sin curse with the component. If you Punished at least 1 Original Sin this turn, double this damage; if you Forgave last turn, gain Block equal to the damage.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZUI_ZHAI_DI_YA.title: Mortgaged Sin
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZUI_ZHAI_DI_YA.descrip: Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#6666cc]Block[/color]. Then choose: 1) Forgive 1 Original Sin in hand then Exhaust it; 2) Punish 1 Original Sin in hand then Exhaust it.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZUI_ZHAI_DI_YA.forgive: Choose 1 Original Sin to Forgive then Exhaust
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZUI_ZHAI_DI_YA.punishP: Choose 1 Original Sin to Punish then Exhaust
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_IGNITE.title: Ignite
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_IGNITE.description: Gain {IgnitePower:diff()} [b][Ignite][/b]. At the start or end of your turn, attack a number of times equal to your stacks, dealing damage equal to your stacks to random targets (friend or foe). Hitting an enemy: a random ally gains 1 Block; if that enemy lacks Vulnerable, apply 1 Vulnerable. Hitting an ally: deal 1 damage to it instead, then this power gains 2 stacks.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_UNWANTEDKINDNESS.title: 不需要的善意
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_UNWANTEDKINDNESS.descr: 获得{Block:diff()}点[color=#6666cc]格挡[/color]；若本次烧掉牌，抽1张。
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETURNEDHAIRRIBBON.des: 获得{Block:diff()}点[color=#6666cc]格挡[/color]，造成{Damage:diff()}点[color=#6666cc]伤害[/color]。从弃牌堆取回1张牌，使其获得[color=#ff0000]余火[/color]。
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DONTLOOKATME.title: 请别看见我
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DONTLOOKATME.descripti: 选择1张手牌获得[color=#ff0000]余火[/color]；若它本回合被烧掉，抽1张。{IfUpgraded:show:被烧掉时获得6点[color=#6666cc]格挡[/color]。|}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BROKENTRUST.title: 坏掉的信任
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BROKENTRUST.descriptio: 造成{Damage:diff()}点[color=#6666cc]伤害[/color]。选择1张手牌获得[color=#ff0000]余火[/color]；这张牌的余火优先连接抽牌堆或弃牌堆中的攻击牌，若选择攻击牌，返还{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_HOLDMYPAIN.title: 替我保管痛觉
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_HOLDMYPAIN.description: 余火获得：每回合前{IfUpgraded:show:2|1}次烧牌时，可右键强化候选牌。强化后你获得1层亚里沙的魔法；攻击牌给予敌人1层亚里沙的魔法，技能牌获得1能量，能力牌使所有牌中1张牌获得余火。
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DAZZLINGTOLERANCE.desc: 余火烧掉牌时，随机造成1点伤害并获得2点[color=#6666cc]格挡[/color]；烧掉诅咒时触发3次。
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BURNEDAPOLOGY.title: 把道歉烧成灰
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BURNEDAPOLOGY.descript: Embers gain: if the burned card can be played, auto-play it once for free, then burn it. Auto-played cards do not trigger Embers.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_UNNEEDEDGOODCHILD.desc: 强化本回合下一次余火：按被烧掉牌费用造成等量次1点伤害；若其费用大于3且自带余火，额外获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。可右键强化1张候选牌，使其本次费用+1。
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TWOSEPARATEDENDS.title: 隔开的两端
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TWOSEPARATEDENDS.descr: 你的余火：若选择原牌，获得{Block:diff()}点[color=#6666cc]格挡[/color]；若选择连接牌，抽{Cards:diff()}张牌并使其本次费用-1。
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BEFOREFORGIVEN.title: 被原谅之前
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BEFOREFORGIVEN.descrip: 造成{Damage:diff()}点[color=#6666cc]伤害[/color]；若本次烧牌，额外造成{BurnDamage:diff()}点[color=#6666cc]伤害[/color]；若烧掉大于2费的牌，将其本次费用-1后返回手牌。
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_GLASSHUG.title: 隔着玻璃的拥抱
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_GLASSHUG.description: 获得{Block:diff()}点[color=#6666cc]格挡[/color]。若本牌被烧掉，下回合开始回到手牌，费用变为0，并获得本牌格挡值的格挡。
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_STAYINGSTILLHURTS.desc: 烧掉1张手牌。若它有余火，随机触发所有牌中1张带余火牌的选牌，并使其本次打出费用{IfUpgraded:show:-2|-1}；否则抽1张。
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DONTBRINGMEHOME.title: 别把我带回家
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DONTBRINGMEHOME.descri: 获得{Block:diff()}点[color=#6666cc]格挡[/color]。选择1张手牌获得余火和保留。回合结束若仍在手牌，烧掉它；下回合获得{Energy:energyIcons()}并抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DONTBRINGMEHOME.select: 选择1张手牌获得余火和保留
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_WARMTHSHOULDNOTSTAY.de: 每当你打出带余火的牌后，随机1张没有余火的所有牌获得余火。
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BURNEDECHO.title: 烧断回音
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BURNEDECHO.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}点[color=#6666cc]伤害[/color]。本回合每有1张牌被余火烧掉，本牌伤害+{BurnBonus:diff()}；打出后费用在下回合开始前+1。
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_FIFTHSELFPROOF.title: 第五次自证
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_FIFTHSELFPROOF.descrip: 造成等于本牌计数的1点[color=#6666cc]伤害[/color]。每完成5次手动余火选择，本牌获得1计数。使用余火时，可消耗计数右键强化候选牌：攻击牌攻击次数+1；技能牌本次被选择并打出时额外打出1次；能力牌随机获得1张费用-1且带余火的能力牌。当前计数：{FireCount:diff()}。

Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Consume the earliest {Consume:diff()} Fire Color given to the target this turn; its consume effect is doubled.

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_UNSEENKINDLING.title: 没看见的火种
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_UNSEENKINDLING.descrip: 选择1名敌人。若其没有火色，给予2格火色；若已有火色，给予1格火色并抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。{IfUpgraded:show:获得{Block:diff()}点[color=#6666cc]格挡[/color]。|}

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ASHINPAGES.description:
Give ALL enemies {Fire:diff()} Fire Color.

{IfUpgraded:show:Give 1 Fire Color.|If the target is no longer full as a result, give 1 Fire Color.}

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DEADLINEHANDOFF.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeats:diff()} times. After each hit, consume 1 Fire Color.
Each Chain this card triggers resolves its Chain effect one extra time.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TEMPERATUREPROOF.title: 温差证明
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TEMPERATUREPROOF.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Give 1 Fire Color, then consume 1. Gain {Block:diff()} Block.

Your effects that give Fire Color give 1 more.

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SAMEWRONGPROBLEM.title: 同一道错题
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SAMEWRONGPROBLEM.descr:

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TOMORROWBURN.title: 留到明天的烫伤
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TOMORROWBURN.descripti:
Give {Fire:diff()} Fire Color.

If at least 6 were consumed, draw {Cards:diff()} cards and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_WEIGHT_OF_PAIN.descrip: Whenever [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] burns {IfUpgraded:show:1 card|2 cards}, gain 1 [b]Strength[/b] for the rest of combat.

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ASH_AFTERGLOW.title: Ash Afterglow
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ASH_AFTERGLOW.descript: Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#6666cc]Block[/color] for each card burned by [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] this turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SECOND_KINDLING.title: Second Kindling
